entries.037f145affb3a8ec: Revenue from construction work and charters
entries.23704e4da55a2551: By region, revenue from Brazil is the largest, followed by Guyana, and large-scale projects for deepwater oil and gas field development in South America form the core of the business. The company explains that demand for ultra-deepwater and deepwater oil and gas fields is expected to remain high going forward, and that this is an area where its competitive strengths can be leveraged.
entries.29ab3a76c14b00ae: It earns revenue from construction fees based on the progress of construction projects, and from providing charter and operation services. Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥717,100 million.
entries.2cfe1c802132de9f: Under its Medium-Term Management Plan 2024-2026, "Opening a Sustainable Future through Innovation," it first sets out strengthening earnings power, and in its business operations it plans to promote decarbonization of its core FPSO business and develop new businesses, while in parallel strengthening its business foundation, including human capital. In offshore wind power and alternative energy businesses, it also states that it will promote the development of its own floating structures and mooring technologies.
entries.331d5f94cd629c7c: Floating Offshore Oil and Gas Production Facilities Business
entries.352ccfd8a3e44bd6: Based on the revenue by region in the segment information (fiscal year ended December 2025) and the description of the business environment in [Management's Policies, Business Environment and Issues to Address, etc.].
entries.3bb8002bbf369ea8: As a fabless company without its own factories or shipyards, it specializes in design, procurement and construction management, and its structure outsources construction to shipyards and specialist contractors around the world. In the charter business, it establishes affiliated companies for each project and holds facilities through joint ventures with shipping companies and general trading companies, so the long-term funding burden and project risk are shared with its partners.
entries.4b9d1827c188c917: This service combines leasing, in which affiliates own FPSOs and FSOs and lease them to clients, with operation services in which offshore installed facilities are operated for oil and gas production, maintenance inspection and management.
entries.4f62f6f0d62d0bd1: FPSO (floating production, storage and offloading facility for offshore oil and gas)
entries.55473ef5c45a8a34: FSO (floating storage and offloading facility for offshore oil and gas)
entries.590c982a684314c1: This is a service that receives orders for the design, procurement, construction and installation of floating offshore oil and gas production facilities as a package and provides them to clients. As a fabless company with no factories or shipyards of its own, it specializes in project management such as design, procurement and construction management, and outsources construction and installation to overseas shipyards and specialist contractors.
entries.5b834151d7d5c345: EPCI (engineering, procurement, construction and installation) of floating offshore oil and gas production facilities
entries.644bae49787e3a90: This service provides after-sales services, such as parts supply and engineering support for FPSOs and other facilities built and delivered to oil and gas developers, as well as management support and operation support for affiliates and jointly controlled entities.
entries.654c1d3a0ed7afdf: Government-owned or private oil and gas development companies overseas
entries.9497ed270c8d4ea9: MODEC is a company that provides floating offshore oil and gas production facilities, including FPSOs, in an integrated manner from design and construction to ownership, leasing and operation.
entries.a0673bb84b9876a0: Other services such as after-sales services
entries.a31086f1f9981464: This is a service that receives orders for the design, procurement, construction and installation of floating offshore oil and gas production facilities as a package and provides them to clients.
entries.aa17700021679224: It provides total solutions for floating offshore oil and gas production facilities such as FPSOs, FSOs and TLPs, combining EPCI (engineering, procurement, construction and installation), leasing of facilities that it owns and rents out, and operations that handle the operation of the facilities.
entries.ad4c3a4f3e8da341: Overseas oil and gas development companies
entries.bc71c3024320b155: Total solutions for floating production facilities
entries.c11b04c25f267577: Its main customers are government-affiliated or private oil and gas development companies in various countries overseas. For the fiscal year ended December 2025, its main customers included ExxonMobil Guyana Limited, Equinor Energy do Brasil Ltda. and Shell Brasil Petróleo Ltda., and in the charter business conducted by affiliated companies, Petrobras is the largest customer.
entries.cfef88a7e8539d52: It secures profit through the construction of floating production facilities and the provision of long-term charter and operation services. Profit attributable to owners of the parent for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥56,456 million.
entries.d5f08ad7baede326: The group, consisting of the company, 24 subsidiaries and 21 affiliates, handles the design, construction, ownership and operation of floating production, storage and offloading facilities such as FPSOs, FSOs and TLPs used in the midstream area of offshore oil and gas production.
entries.d9d4972afda076f9: This service combines leasing, in which affiliates own FPSOs and FSOs and lease them to clients, with operation services in which offshore installed facilities are operated for oil and gas production, maintenance inspection and management. For each project, affiliates are established and operated as joint ventures with partners centered on shipping companies and general trading companies.
entries.df82ec217fad8f80: The group, consisting of the company, 24 subsidiaries and 21 affiliates, handles the design, construction, ownership and operation of floating production, storage and offloading facilities such as FPSOs, FSOs and TLPs used in the midstream area of offshore oil and gas production. The business consists of almost a single segment, and revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥717,100 million.
entries.e36772e21d2f7423: The group consists of the company, 24 subsidiaries and 21 affiliated companies (as of December 31, 2025). As a fabless company without its own factories or shipyards, it specializes in project management. Consolidated employees number 6,460 (fiscal year ended December 2025).
entries.eea1e6bbff7cb9a5: Based on the business promotion structure described in [Business Overview] (being fabless, and the policy of establishing affiliated companies for each project and developing through joint ventures).
